exposure: In vitro fertilization with autologous oocytes
cohort: 100 women with twin pregnancies (50 after oocyte donation and 50 after in vitro fertilization with autologous oocytes)
finding: Twin pregnancies after oocyte donation are associated with a higher risk of preterm birth before 37 weeks of gestation, but this did not translate into increased rates of adverse perinatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
